title: Re-examining Sexism and Misogyny Classification with Annotator Attitudes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) on their ability to detect and classify sexism, misogyny, and Gender-Based Violence (GBV) in social media datasets (EDOS and DOM).

Using mixed-effects regression to measure how annotators' self-reported sociopolitical attitudes (Right Wing Authoritarianism, Social Dominance Orientation, and Hostile Neosexism) bias their labeling behavior, and testing whether infusing LLM prompts with these annotator profiles causes the models to adopt the corresponding subjective biases.
